description: on_click wired to a Container. Two real Type values observed: JSAction (arbitrary JS in a Code-typed Property) and OpenPopup (a Popup-typed Property naming the target Popup directly, no script).
notes: kf.app.page.setVariable(name, value) + kf.app.page.openPopup(id) called TOGETHER inside one JSAction Code string is the confirmed live pattern for "select a repeater row, then show its detail popup" — openPopup here is an SDK call inside arbitrary Code, not a separate wire Type; OpenPopup as a wire Type (below) is a DIFFERENT, simpler mechanism used when the click needs to do nothing but open a popup.

kf.client.showInfo(...) is documented as a valid call in this same Code slot; its exact call signature was not independently re-verified in this pass beyond that prose mention — the surrounding Code/JSAction wire shape is what is actually confirmed live.

OpenPopup's Property carries no script at all: Type:"Popup", Name:"popup_params", Value is directly the target Popup's id — the simplest of the two mechanisms, prefer it when the click does nothing but open a popup with no page-state side effect.
Container::EventMapping is the back-ref key regardless of whether the Container Type is a plain layout Container or a widget-hosting Component container — both were observed live.
